answer_1.quote: Singing Voice Synthesis (SVS) converts the lyrics into natural and humanlike voice audio according to the music scores

answer_2.quote: In objective evaluation, we use Mean Cepstral Distortion (MCD) and Mean Spectral Distortion (MSD) to evaluate the timbral distortion of synthesized audio. We also select Gross Pitch Error (GPE), Voicing Decision Error (VDE), and F 0 Frame Error (FFE) to evaluate the F 0 track in synthesized audio.

answer_4.quote: 10 volunteers participated in the evaluation without disclosing the audio source.
answer_4.guideline: We conduct a Mean Opinion Score (MOS) for both real and synthesized audio in the test set. MOS mainly evaluates the human subjective perception of audio naturalness. The rating range of MOS is from 1 to 5. 1 represents the lowest naturalness, and 5 represents the highest naturalness.
